newsitem.title: USA: General Growth Properties buys three malls.
newsitem.headline: General Growth Properties buys three malls.

text.p: General Growth Properties said Monday it acquired three regional shopping malls in Michigan from a group led by Forbes/Cohen Properties.

The properties are the Lansing Mall in Lansing, the Lakeview Square Mall in Battle Creek and the Westwood Mall in Jackson. The malls will bring in an estimated $13.5 million in net operating income in 1996, said General Growth.
The buyer said it paid $4 million in cash, $40 million of operating units in General Growth Properties Limited Partnership and assumed $90 million in debt.
General Growth owns and manages shopping centers.
